text:
Samira (People Ops): Quick heads-up — my sister's visiting tomorrow around 11:30am for a quick tour & lunch. Can we get a visitor badge ready? She'll need desk seating for ~90 minutes and there's a bulky box she'll drop off at reception.

Liam (Front Desk): Got it — I'll prep a temporary badge. Should it be 'visitor' or 'contractor' access? Also, any name I should put on the pass?

Samira (People Ops): Visitor is fine. Use 'Hannah Rivera' and mark 'meeting' for expiry. Please put the badge in the top mail tray and text me when they're checked in.

Jordan (Office Manager): Re: seating — the long table by the kitchenette is usually full. We can free up a couch in the visitor lounge and move the beanbag to the meeting room. @Avery ok to move the beanbag at 10:45?

Avery (Facilities): On it. I'll swap the beanbag and put a 'reserved' sign on the couch.

Maya (Eng): If possible can we reserve a small desk near the window? I'll be out for a call but can vacate my hotdesk 4 from 11:15–12:30. Ping me if you need me to actually log out.

Samira (People Ops): Perfect, thanks @Maya. Liam — the box is fragile electronics and will need to go into locker B2 (front desk can use the small locker). Label on it says 'fragile — please keep upright'.

DevBot: Package scanned: 1 item (fragile) from FastShip. Tracking: FS123456789. Photo: https://img.redwood/workspace/pack-1937801124.jpg

Liam (Front Desk): Locker B2 assigned. I'll place the badge + a sticky note on the box. Also left an internal note: 'Visitor Hannah, lunch meeting, badge expires 1:00pm'

Samira (People Ops): :thumbsup: thank you everyone. One more: can someone collect the box at 1:00pm? If no one grabs it, I'll arrange courier pickup.

Jordan (Office Manager): I'll grab it — tucking into a client call until 12:50 but can swing by.

Maya (Eng): :wave: I'll set a reminder at 12:55 just in case.
